title: Czaky Test for Hydroxamate-Type Siderophores
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.icqcavw
materials: Read at 543 nm using a spectrophotometer

steps.title: Prepare sample volume
steps.instruction: Transfer the siderophore sample to a final volume of 2 mL in a 20 mL tube.

steps.title: Add sulfuric acid and autoclave
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 3 M sulfuric acid (Fisher Scientific Catalog #A300C-212) to the tube, then autoclave for 4 h at 121 °C. For a blank, replace the acid with 2 mL distilled H₂O.

substeps.instruction: For blank, use H₂O instead of acid

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: After cooling, add 7 mL of 2 M sodium acetate (catalog P212121) and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add sulfanilamide
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 1 % sulfanilamide prepared in 30 % v/v acetic acid (contributed by users) and mix.

steps.title: Add iodine solution
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 0.65 % iodine solution prepared in 1 % w/v potassium iodide (catalog P212121) and mix.

steps.title: Add sodium arsenate
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 1.5 % sodium arsenate solution and mix.

steps.title: Add NNED reagent
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 0.05 % n-(napthyl) ethylene diamine (NNED) solution and mix.

steps.title: Remove particulates
steps.instruction: Spin the tube to pellet any particulate matter and discard the supernatant (or retain as required).

steps.title: Prepare hydroxamate standard
steps.instruction: Prepare a standard curve using hydroxylamine (contributed by users) according to the assay requirements.
